pins.name: MISO
pins.label: MISO (GPIO0)
pins.notes: PIN_SPI0_MISO - SPI0 bus shared between the onboard LIS2D accelerometer and MAX31865 RTD temperature sensor ('// Shared between LIS2D and MAX31865' per this board's own pins_arduino.h). Dedicated, not general purpose.

pins.name: SS
pins.label: SS (GPIO1)
pins.notes: PIN_SPI0_SS / PIN_LIS_CS - onboard LIS2D accelerometer's dedicated SPI chip-select, also the SPI0 bus's hardware SS line (same GPIO). Dedicated, not general purpose.

pins.name: SCK
pins.label: SCK (GPIO2)
pins.notes: PIN_SPI0_SCK - shared SPI0 clock for the onboard LIS2D accelerometer + MAX31865 sensor. Dedicated, not general purpose.

pins.name: MOSI
pins.label: MOSI (GPIO3)
pins.notes: PIN_SPI0_MOSI - shared SPI0 data line for the onboard LIS2D accelerometer + MAX31865 sensor. Dedicated, not general purpose.

pins.name: D5
pins.label: GPIO5 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_LED = PIN_NEOPIXEL (same GPIO) - this board's single onboard WS2812-style NeoPixel doubles as its LED_BUILTIN; no separate plain LED exists.

pins.name: D20
pins.label: D20 (GPIO20)
pins.notes: NEOPIXEL_POWER - onboard NeoPixel power-enable/gate line, grouped under this board's own '// NeoPixel' comment header alongside PIN_NEOPIXEL. Dedicated, not general purpose. (This GPIO is also assigned PIN_SERIAL1_TX later in the file, but PIN_SERIAL1_RX is sentineled to (31u)/not pinned out, so Serial1 cannot function as a real UART on this board regardless.)

pins.name: D24
pins.label: D24 (GPIO24)
pins.notes: PIN_MAX31865_CS - onboard MAX31865 RTD temperature-sensor chip's dedicated SPI chip-select ('//MAX31865' comment). Was also exposed as a plain D24 general-purpose alias - corrected here; driving this pin generically would corrupt communication with the onboard sensor.

pins.name: D25
pins.label: D25 (GPIO25)
pins.notes: PIN_LIS_INTERRUPT1 - onboard LIS2D accelerometer's interrupt output line ('//Accelerometer' comment; the vendor's own commented-out prior assignment at GPIO23 confirms GPIO25 is the currently active pin). Was also exposed as a plain D25 general-purpose alias - corrected here.

pins.name: D29/A3
pins.label: D29/A3 (GPIO29)
pins.notes: PIN_CAN_INTERRUPT - onboard CAN transceiver's interrupt line ('// CAN bus' comment). Was also exposed as plain D29/A3 general-purpose aliases - corrected here.
